NEWS UPDATE │The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) assured the public that all traffic violators apprehended under the No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) are subject to a thorough manual review and verification process to ensure accuracy.

This assurance followed the agency’s approval of an appeal made by a motorist cited under the NCAP for allegedly violating the number coding scheme last September.

The motorist, identified only as Mr. Escano, contested his traffic violation through the MMDA Traffic Adjudication Division online filing platform.

He insisted that his car is registered as an electric vehicle and is exempt from the number coding scheme in accordance with Republic Act 11697, also known as the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act (EVIDA Law). 

MMDA Chairman Romando Artes approved the appealed traffic violation and apologized to Escano. │Joel Zurbano
